latest_release.name: v3.2.31: Qoder joins the installer and the plugin doors
latest_release.body:
**Qoder joins the installer and becomes the tenth plugin door.** The installer writes Qoder's own skill folder and the `AGENTS.md` pointer it already reads, and `.qoder-plugin/plugin.json` loads the same six skills through **Settings > Plugins**. A new repository check makes sure no future door can ship unnamed in the single file.

## A folder of its own, and a pointer

Qoder documents `.qoder/skills/` for a project and `~/.qoder/skills/` at user level, so the installer writes those paths rather than the shared `.agents/skills/` folder. Qoder also loads `AGENTS.md` as project rules, which is where the session pointer goes on a project install.

The installer now covers sixteen agents over ten project folders.

## The plugin door

`.qoder-plugin/plugin.json` points at the same `skills/` folder as the other doors. Qoder imports a plugin from a local folder, so the plugin route is a clone of this repository and an import in **Settings > Plugins**.

The plugin was imported into Qoder 0.5.11 at user scope. The registry listed `antislop@local` 3.2.31 as enabled, the cache held the manifest and all six skill folders, and a fresh session found all six skills by name with the core loading without error.

`npx antislop-ai --update` now names an installed Qoder plugin copy too, read from Qoder's own registry, so the update is reported next to the other doors.

## The door list that fell behind

The single file `antislop.md` names every plugin door and its update command by hand. It still said seven after Qoder was added, so Qoder now appears there and the count is eight.

A new check in `scripts/check-repo.mjs` compares that list against the plugin doors the installer knows about, including the count in prose, so the same drift cannot ship again. The repository check is now fifteen checks.

## What is verified, and what is not

This repository passes its own fifteen checks, and CI is green on Ubuntu, macOS, Windows, and the minimum Node version. The installer smoke test passes.

The skill paths, the `AGENTS.md` rule file, and the user-level folder come from Qoder's own documentation. The plugin manifest is not in the public documentation: its path and fields come from the plugin-creator specification bundled with Qoder 0.5.11, and the live import above is what confirms them.

The import ran through Qoder's installer API, which performs the same validation, install, and enable transaction the Plugins page uses. The Plugins card itself was not captured, because the app does not expose that window; the registry, the cache layout, and the fresh-session output are the evidence.

From community PR #67.

## Updating

The installer route is unchanged:

```bash
npx antislop-ai --update
```

It replaces every antislop folder already on this machine at both scopes and prints the release it replaced. A Qoder project installed before this release has no antislop folder yet, so run `npx antislop-ai` once and select Qoder.

The plugin keeps its own copy under Qoder. To update it, pull the clone and import the same folder again in **Settings > Plugins**. Skills load when a session starts, so start a new one afterwards.

detail.readme:
# Anti Slop: Rules for AI Coding Agents npx antislop-ai [Website](https://antislop.ai.id) · [Guide](GUIDE.md) · [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md) · [Install](#install) · [Skills](#skills) · [FAQ](#faq) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/antislop-ai?style=flat-square&color=cb3837&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/antislop-ai) [![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-20.12%2B-339933?style=flat-square&logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white)](cli/package.json) [![skills.sh](https://skills.sh/b/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop?style=flat-square)](https://skills.sh/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop) [![MIT license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-f4c430?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join-5865F2?style=flat-square&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/VWKggJfHFR)
--- **antislop** is a rulebook an AI coding agent reads every session. It stops generic UI, text, and AI-shaped code, and it is a filter, not a style guide: no colors, fonts, or layouts prescribed, direction stays yours. Inside are 40 rules in three tiers, a Liveliness Toolkit, a mandatory PASS/FAIL report, and six skills that load only when a task needs them. It cannot invent direction, so DESIGN.md supplies that, and antislop never beautifies on its own. ## Before and after Each pair below is one brief, run twice, so the difference is visible side by side. ### UI With /antislop-ui. antislop alone is not the after. It removes the slop and stops there; direction comes from `DESIGN.md`. For UI work you intend to ship, that file is mandatory: without it the result is labelled a draft without direction. The pair below is the result. | **Before: without antislop** | **After: antislop + `DESIGN.md`** | |:--|:--| | | | | This is what most AI output looks like: slop everywhere once you take a closer look. | Much better. antislop kills the slop, and `DESIGN.md` gives it a real visual direction. | The two partial states are worth seeing, because each one shows why the other half matters: | **Partial: antislop alone** | **Partial: `DESIGN.md` alone** | |:--|:--| | | | | The slop is gone, but so is the direction. That is why antislop needs a `DESIGN.md`. | The direction is there, but honestly it is still far from good: the slop still shows. | ### Copywriting With /antislop-copywriting. One prompt, run twice. ### Accessibility With /antislop-human. One sign-in form, run twice. ### Mobile layout With /antislop-layoutmobile. One dashboard on a phone, run twice. ### Code With /antislop-code. One file, run twice. Every image here opens full size if you click it. ## Install antislop ships as standard agent skills: one folder per skill, holding a `SKILL.md`. Installation differs per agent, so pick the section for the one you use. Each route is walked through from zero, with update and removal, in [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md#install-update-and-remove). ### The installer (recommended) One command, then answer the prompts. It asks which skills you want, where to install them (this project or everywhere), and which agents you use, then copies the folders and writes the pointer that reloads antislop every session. ```bash npx antislop-ai ``` ### The skills directory antislop is listed on [skills.sh](https://skills.sh/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop), the open directory for agent skills. This copies the same folders as the installer and nothing else, so antislop reloads by description alone. ```bash npx skills add miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` ### Claude Code - Plugin ```text /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop /plugin install antislop@anti-slop ``` ### Antigravity - Plugin ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` ### Codex - Plugin ```bash codex plugin marketplace add miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop codex plugin add antislop@anti-slop ``` ### Cursor - Plugin ```bash agent plugin marketplace add https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` Then open **Customize**, find **antislop**, and select **Install**. ### Kimi Code - Plugin ```text /plugins install https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` ### DeepSeek Harness - Plugin Open **Plugins**, choose **Add plugin**, paste this package name, and select **Install**: ```text antislop-ai ``` That is the desktop route. From a terminal instead, name the profile you use: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add antislop-ai ``` ### Cline - Plugin ```bash cline plugin install https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop.git ``` This door covers the Cline CLI. For the VS Code or JetBrains extension, use the installer. ### Muse Code - Plugin Muse Code keeps its plugin system behind an opt-in flag, so set it first. On macOS and Linux: ```bash export MUSE_EXPERIMENTAL_PLUGINS=1 muse plugins marketplace add anti-slop miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop muse plugins install antislop@anti-slop ``` On Windows, set `$env:MUSE_EXPERIMENTAL_PLUGINS = "1"` in PowerShell first, then run the two `muse` lines unchanged. Skills load without another step. Run `muse plugins approve antislop` to enable the contrast MCP server. ### Qoder - Plugin Qoder imports a plugin from a local folder, so clone this repository first: ```bash git clone https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop.git ``` Then open **Settings > Plugins** in Qoder, click **+ Create Plugin**, and choose the import-from-local-folder option. Qoder reads `.qoder-plugin/plugin.json`, which points at the same `skills/` folder as every other door. Qoder's own documentation also names the skills directory route, with its agent flag: `npx skills add miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop -a qoder`. Pick one route, not both. ### Oh My Pi - Plugin ```bash omp plugin marketplace add miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop omp plugin install antislop@anti-slop ``` ### Pi - Package ```bash pi install git:github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` ### The single file `antislop.md` on its own is a complete filter you can paste into any chat window, with no packaging and no folders. ```bash curl -o antislop.md https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop/main/antislop.md ``` ## Skills | Skill | Covers | Pick it for | |-------|--------|-------------| | antislop | The core filter: rules, tiers, the Delivery Gate, liveliness | Everything. Always loaded | | antislop-ui | Layout, color, components, decoration, motion, structure, performance | UI and visual work | | antislop-copywriting | Headlines, CTAs, tone, fake stats, anti-AI writing, markdown hygiene | Copy and text | | antislop-human | Contrast, keyboard, focus, states, interaction affordances | Accessibility | | antislop-layoutmobile | Reflow across screen widths, breakpoints, grids, overflow, tap targets | Responsive work | | antislop-code | AI-slop comments: which to remove, which to keep | Comment cleanup | Install one, several, or the core alone. ## Usage modes antislop runs one of two ways, and by default the agent asks which at the start of every session. - **During** guides the work while it is built, and closes with the Delivery Gate report. - **After** audits work that already exists: a numbered findings list, you approve what to fix, then a follow-up report. To skip the question, save a preference once: ```bash npx antislop-ai --mode during ``` Use `after` for the other mode. Everything else, from `--mode ask` to where the setting lives, is in [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md#usage-modes). ## Update antislop does not update itself. If you installed through the installer, one command replaces what is already there, in this project and under your home directory, and prints the release it replaced: ```bash npx antislop-ai --update ``` A plugin keeps its own copy under the agent that installed it, so it updates through its own manager, and the Pi package updates through Pi. Every route is listed in [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md#install-update-and-remove). Skills load when a session starts, so start a new one afterwards. ## FAQ **Is antislop a style guide?** No, a filter. It rejects technique without purpose and requires liveliness. Direction is yours. **Which agents does it work with?** Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode, Cursor, Cline, Amp, Gemini CLI, Hermes, GitHub Copilot, Kimi Code, DeepSeek Harness, Muse Code, Kilo Code, Qoder, Pi, and Oh My Pi. The installer covers sixteen of them and detects which ones you have, and the plugin doors install from this same repository. [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md) lists the folder each agent reads. **What is a skill?** A folder that goes deeper into one concern, holding a `SKILL.md` with its rules. Skills reference the core rules by number and never duplicate them, so adding one does not change the core. ## Roadmap **v3.2.31** adds Qoder to the installer and the plugin doors: - **A folder of its own.** Qoder reads `.qoder/skills/` in a project and `~/.qoder/skills/` at user level, and it loads `AGENTS.md` as project rules, so a project install writes the pointer block there too. - **The plugin.** `.qoder-plugin/plugin.json` points at the same `skills/` folder, so a folder import in **Settings > Plugins** loads all six skills from this repository. The installer also names an installed plugin copy when `--update` runs. Every earlier release, and what comes next, is in [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md). ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop&Date) ## Contributors Thanks to everyone who helps make antislop better.

Found a new slop pattern, a rule that missed something, or a bug in the installer? Open an [issue](https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop/issues). What a pull request has to carry is in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), and behavior in issues and pull requests is covered by [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

“antislop is a filter, not magic.
It clears the slop from your UI, text, and code.
A beautiful UI is DESIGN.md's job, and yours.”

## Disclaimer Get antislop from [miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop](https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop), [antislop.ai.id](https://antislop.ai.id), or the [antislop-ai npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/antislop-ai). The npm name `antislop` belongs to a different package, so `npx antislop` does not install this project. There is no antislop coin, token, or fundraising. Any crypto coin, token, NFT, or fundraising that uses the antislop name was not created by this project and is a scam. antislop accepts donations only through the Sponsor button on this repository and [Saweria](https://saweria.co/antislop); anyone collecting money in its name anywhere else is not authorized. ## License MIT: [LICENSE](LICENSE)
